keyMessages.text: most of our slots range between 94% and 99% RTP. Our custom Yeet Original games have the following RTPs: 99% for Dice, Limbo, Coin Flip, Plinko, and Risky Click; 98% for Minter and Coin Race; and 97% for Lamb Chop.

keyMessages.author: Keyboard Monkey
keyMessages.text:
Patch Notes 9/4/26

 New

Limits for YEET Originals have gone up dramatically.  Keno now has a $1 million dollar max win.
,

Limits for major slot providers have risen to $2.5m cap.
,

We’ve added shareable PNL cards to the sportsbook!  Head to the ‘My Bets’ section and click the share icon in the bottom right of your slip to check them out.
,

 Improvements

When a user is tipped, we now display the tip currency in chat.
,

On web, launching games no longer requires selecting real money.  To launch demo mode there is now a toggle under the game window.
,

Migrated Lamb Chop and Risky Click to our new game engine.  They are blazingly fast now and click speeds have gone up dramatically.
,

 Fixes

Fixed a bug in the PnL Session Widget that was causing incorrect numbers when using various currencies.
,
keyMessages.whyItMatters: Patch notes say Risky Click moved to a new game engine for speed. Nothing about pricing.

keyMessages.author: Keyboard Monkey
keyMessages.text:
Path Notes 11/13

Improvements

Bet cards are now live! Click on an aura, or any of the Live Wins / Bet Feed to see details about the round played, including detailed Originals information!
,
Live win feed now pauses on hover
,
Promotions row is now Boosted RTP row
,
Combi Bonus for multis in the Sportsbook are now pinned outside the selections list
,
Registration no longer pops up with password complexity requirements
,

Fixes

Fixes chat intermittently forcing the scroll position to the newest message when new messages arrive, preventing users from scrolling up and selecting earlier messages to reply individually. The behavior starts after clicking names to reply
,
Badges on Chairman’s Cup page are now fully aligned
,
Emails now have proper social footers to include Discord and Instagram
,
Tip history now shows paginated results and can show all tips, previous cap was last 20
,
keyMessages.whyItMatters: First patch notes after the 10 November change: bet cards and interface tweaks. Nothing about HiLo or Risky Click pricing, refunds or compensation.

announcements.scope: The 18 posts in #announcements from 5 to 21 November 2026 (UTC), the last before the check, listed by headline. None mentions HiLo or Risky Click pricing, refunds or compensation. Full text stays in YEET's Discord; one post lists winning players by name, so we do not republish the text. Attached images, video and linked pages were not all opened.
